what: Raw `tmux -CC attach` control-mode output captured from this host, so a parser is proven against real bytes rather than a spec reading.

entrySequence.note: DCS 1000 p -- ESC P 1000 p. Control mode opens with this, NOT with a % line. A parser that only scans for lines beginning with % will swallow it into the first message.

idSigils.note: '%output %16 ...' is message type %output addressed to PANE 16. The second % is an id sigil, not a second message type.

payloadEscaping.note: Unescape before writing to the terminal, or panes render literal backslashes.

attachReplaysNothing.note: The scratch session had already printed three lines; only the two emitted AFTER attach arrived as %output. The real seat, mid-conversation and idle, produced no %output at all. A client MUST fetch existing screen and history (capture-pane -p -S) on attach, or every panel opens blank and fills only as the agent next speaks.

scratchWithOutput.description: Scratch session emitting colour and CRLF, to exercise %output and escaping.

realSeatIdle.description: A live Devin planner seat, attached READ-ONLY (-r) at matched size. Idle agents are silent, so volume tracks agent speech, not polling.
